question_text: On 2025-12-08 (UTC), compare the crowd activity at DemoBooth_NVIDIA versus DemoBooth_Intel. Which booth was busier, and approximately what was the ratio of their average head_counts?
answer_text: On 2025-12-08, DemoBooth_NVIDIA had an average head count of approximately 15.5, while DemoBooth_Intel had about 10.6. This indicates that DemoBooth_NVIDIA was busier, with a ratio of their average head counts being approximately 1.46:1.

citations.sql:
WITH crowd_activity AS (
    SELECT camera_location, AVG(head_count) AS avg_head_count
    FROM events
    WHERE event_type = 'crowd'
      AND timestamp_utc >= '2025-12-08T00:00:00Z' 
      AND timestamp_utc < '2025-12-09T00:00:00Z'
      AND (camera_location LIKE '%DemoBooth_NVIDIA%' OR camera_location LIKE '%DemoBooth_Intel%')
    GROUP BY camera_location
)
SELECT a.camera_location, a.avg_head_count, 
       CASE 
           WHEN b.avg_head_count > 0 THEN a.avg_head_count / b.avg_head_count 
           ELSE NULL 
       END AS ratio
FROM crowd_activity a
JOIN crowd_activity b ON a.camera_location LIKE '%DemoBooth_NVIDIA%' AND b.camera_location LIKE '%DemoBooth_Intel%'
UNION ALL
SELECT b.camera_location, b.avg_head_count, 
       CASE 
           WHEN a.avg_head_count > 0 THEN b.avg_head_count / a.avg_head_count 
           ELSE NULL 
       END AS ratio
FROM crowd_activity a
JOIN crowd_activity b ON a.camera_location LIKE '%DemoBooth_NVIDIA%' AND b.camera_location LIKE '%DemoBooth_Intel%'
